maciejdzierzek-kling-ai-prompt-generator.description: Write and improve prompts for Kling AI video generation, and pick the right Kling model for the job. Covers image-to-video, text-to-video, multi-shot storyboards, talking avatars from one photo plus audio, motion transfer, video editing of an existing clip, Element Reference for character consistency, Voice Control and voice cloning, native audio and dialogue, first/last frame control, credit and API costs, and troubleshooting failed generations.
